description: This file implements the bbfdm-ubus API for exposing a Data Model over ubus, including handlers for get, set, schema, instances, add, delete, reference path/value, and event handling, as well as initialization and cleanup functions for the ubus context and plugin loading.

methods.name: bbfdm_ctx_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the bbfdm context by cleaning global data, freeing lists, and plugins.

methods.name: is_sync_operate_cmd
methods.description: Determines if an operate command should be executed synchronously; always returns false.

methods.name: fill_optional_data
methods.description: Fills optional data in the data structure based on the provided blob message.

methods.name: get_value_by_reference_path
methods.description: Retrieves the reference value associated with a given reference path.

methods.name: async_req_free
methods.description: Frees an asynchronous request structure.

methods.name: async_complete_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when an asynchronous request completes, sends reply and cleans up.

methods.name: async_req_new
methods.description: Creates a new asynchronous request structure.

methods.name: bbfdm_start_deferred
methods.description: Starts a deferred (asynchronous) operation, forking a subprocess to execute the callback.

methods.name: bbfdm_get_handler
methods.description: Handles 'get' requests over ubus, parsing parameters and invoking get functions.

methods.name: bbfdm_schema_handler
methods.description: Handles 'schema' requests, returning data model schema.

methods.name: bbfdm_instances_handler
methods.description: Handles 'instances' requests, returning list of data model instances.

methods.name: bbfdm_set_handler
methods.description: Handles 'set' requests, setting data model values.

methods.name: bbfdm_operate_handler
methods.description: Handles 'operate' commands, executing operations synchronously or deferred.

methods.name: bbfdm_add_handler
methods.description: Handles 'add' requests, adding new data model entries.

methods.name: bbfdm_del_handler
methods.description: Handles 'del' requests, deleting data model entries.

methods.name: bbfdm_ref_path_handler
methods.description: Handles 'reference_path' requests, retrieving reference data.

methods.name: bbfdm_ref_value_handler
methods.description: Handles 'reference_value' requests, retrieving reference value.

methods.name: regiter_ubus_object
methods.description: Registers the ubus object with the context.

methods.name: send_linker_response_event
methods.description: Sends a linker response event over ubus.

methods.name: bbfdm_linker_cb
methods.description: Callback for linker events, handling cleanup or request processing.

methods.name: bbfdm_ctx_init
methods.description: Initializes the bbfdm context lists.

methods.name: load_micro_service_config
methods.description: Loads microservice plugin configuration based on service name.

methods.name: load_micro_service_data_model
methods.description: Loads the data model plugin (internal or external) for the microservice.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_regiter_init
methods.description: Initializes ubus connection, loads plugins, registers object and event handlers.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_regiter_free
methods.description: Frees resources, unregisters handlers, and shuts down ubus.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_set_service_name
methods.description: Sets the service name and output name for the context.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_set_log_level
methods.description: Sets the log level mask.

methods.name: bbfdm_ubus_load_data_model
methods.description: Loads the data model into the context.
